title: Adaptive region & tier schema curator for routing DSL
creator: Eleanor Zhang
description: Refactor the routing policy engine to introduce an explicit, versioned schema curator that validates and normalizes region selection, tier routing, and fallback model variant rules. This work creates a compatibility shim to accept older DSL shapes while producing a canonical AST used by the runtime router, improves validation errors to be actionable, and adds deterministic fallback resolution order for reduced runtime surprises.
acceptance_criteria: New schema curator accepts legacy routing config v1 and v1.1 and emits canonical v2 AST with metadata tags
Policy validation surfaces clear, line-numbered errors with suggested fixes for common misconfigurations (e.g., overlapping region selectors, missing fallback variants)
Deterministic fallback ordering documented and implemented: tier affinity -> explicit region weights -> model-variant priority -> global default
End-to-end automated tests (unit + integration) cover 95% of new curator code paths and include property-based tests for random rule sets
Migration path: safe toggle that rewrites stored policies to canonical v2 in a background job with audit logs and ability to roll back
No customer-facing SLO regressions when running canary deployment for two weeks in us-west and eu-central
Observability: per-policy validation metrics (validation_errors_total), rewrite_count, canonicalization_latency_ms visible in Console
Compatibility shim disabled by default after migration and gated behind feature flag

2026-02-14: Prototype curator implemented that emits a canonical AST for a subset of rules. Basic unit tests added.
2026-02-19: Design review with PM and Runtime team. Decided deterministic fallback order and telemetry fields. Agreed on migration job strategy and audit log schema.
2026-02-23: Integration tests added for canary route in us-west. Initial metrics show canonicalization latency median 2.4ms under 2000 req/s sampling.
2026-02-26: Preparing RFC for broader rollout and adding property-based tests and fuzzer harness. Security review requested on 2026-03-01.
2026-02-26: Blocker: One legacy config shape with computed region weights (external webhook) needs special handling; investigating safe sandboxing options.

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Canonicalization latency spikes could increase config apply time during bursts. Mitigation: introduce async background normalizer with optimistic acceptance and a synchronous fast-path for small rules.

Risk: Silent behavioral changes for customers with malformed legacy rules. Mitigation: run rewrite in dry-run mode for 2 cycles, surface diffs in audit log, and notify org owners before enabling rewrite.
Risk: Fuzzer-generated policies may expose nondeterministic ordering bugs. Mitigation: add determinism checks and snapshot-based replay harness.
Risk: Migration job impacts DB IO. Mitigation: rate-limit rewrite jobs, retry with backoff, and monitor rewrite_count metric.
Risk: Edge-case integrations (external region weight webhooks). Mitigation: validate external inputs, sandbox evaluation, and fall back to last-known-good or static fallback.
Risk: Security review required for storing canonical ASTs containing org-specific metadata. Mitigation: encryption-at-rest and KMS tagging policy.
implementation_notes: Introduce a new package: internal/policy/curator with a public Compose() function that accepts raw config blob and returns canonical AST + warnings list.
Use a multi-stage validator: parse -> normalize legacy shapes -> validate schema -> annotate -> emit AST. Each stage returns structured warnings (strings) for users.
Add deterministic ordering helpers: stable-sort by explicit priority then weight then fingerprint. Include stable hashing using xxhash64 to generate fingerprints.
Compatibility shim lives behind feature flag routing.curator.accept_legacy true by default. The background migrator toggles the flag to false only after successful rewrites.
Expose metrics: routing_curator_rewrites_total, routing_curator_errors_total, routing_curator_latency_ms_bucket. Hook into Console for per-org breakdown.
Tests: unit tests for each normalization rule, integration tests using the Router simulator, property-based tests via fast-check style harness, and a YAML fuzzer for stored policies.
Docs: Update /docs/routing/policy-schema.md and add a migration guide and examples for common legacy-to-canonical rewrites. Add example error messages and suggested fixes.
Rollout: canary -> 10% orgs -> 50% orgs -> all orgs, monitor validation_errors_total and route_miss_rate. Stop on >3x increase in route_miss_rate for 1h.
